correctness.rationale: Exact shortest-path distance matrix proves \(K_2=S^0*L_m\) where L_m is two disjoint simplices joined by m isolated bridges. Contracting the two simplex subspaces gives an \(m\)-edge banana graph, proving the integral wedge homotopy type after suspension. The connected triangle-free scale-one graph has cycle rank \(m-1\); diameter three makes all later stages simplices. Explicit orientation identifies both integral homology modules with the augmentation lattice, with pole flip acting -1 at scale one and (-1)(-1)=+1 at scale two. Finite BFS, complete simplex enumeration and mod-two boundary ranks for \(2\le m\le8\), and 608 complete Lefschetz group-element traces for \(2\le m\le5\), corroborate but do not replace the uniform proof.

originality.rationale: Compared exact homotopy, persistence, and integral automorphism representations against the Platonic-solid source arXiv:2302.14388, broad graph-power results arXiv:1104.0433, metric-gluing Theorem 10 DOI:10.4230/LIPIcs.SoCG.2018.3 and finite scale-two subset-metric calculations arXiv:2302.14664. The graph has girth six, not the girth-seven stabilization hypothesis; its three-edge shared arms exceed the permitted gluing bound of two; and it is not an edge-disjoint-six-cycle case or the once-subdivided graph theorem. published-finding corpus and literature alias searches found no covering statement, though unindexed equivalence remains a residual risk. The Platonic-solids article also has an equivariant remark for a dodecahedral filtration; its different graph and symmetry action do not imply this statement.

value.rationale: This is a motivated unbounded family at the first boundary where general high-girth stability fails, with many non-edge-disjoint hexagonal cycles. It gives a complete integral persistence classification, an exact join identity and a full automorphism representation showing an involution reverses first-degree classes yet fixes second-degree classes. Those facts cannot be inferred from the published single-\(6\)-cycle or disjoint-\(6\)-cycle cases and have a natural structural use as a test family for overlapping-cycle Rips topology.
